title: Galilean — Jewett

translations.translation: 伽利略的, 加利利的（位于巴基斯坦北部）

sentences.sentence: 59About an hour later another asserted, "Certainly this fellow was with him, for he is a Galilean."
sentences.translation: 约过了一小时，又有一个人极力地说：“他实在是同那人一夥的，因为他也是加利利人。”

sentences.sentence: Luke takes this passage that he finds later in Mark and he moves it and plops it down at the beginning of Jesus' Galilean ministry.
sentences.translation: 这段原本应在马可福音后半,路加把它提前到了,耶稣加利利布道的开头。

sentences.sentence: At the right side of the frame is ruling gas giant Jupiter, flanked along a line by all four of its Galilean satellites.
sentences.translation: 图片右侧则是巨大的气态行星木星。 它的全部4颗伽利略卫星环绕其周围与之排成一线。

sentences.sentence: When war broke out, they aligned themselves with the rebel forces.
sentences.translation: 战争爆发以后，他们与叛军结了盟。

translations.translation: 高加索的, 白种人的

sentences.sentence: Ann Hamilton was a Caucasian from New England.
sentences.translation: 安·汉密尔顿是来自新英格兰的白人。

sentences.sentence: ...a 25-year-old Caucasian male.
sentences.translation: …一位25岁的白种男子。

translations.translation: 韩国人, 韩国语 a朝鲜人的, 朝鲜语的

phrases.translation: 红新月会（穆斯林国家的一种组织）

sentences.sentence: a small crescent of pastry topped with cheese
sentences.translation: 顶上浇有奶酪的新月形油酥小糕点

sentences.sentence: a crescent moon
sentences.translation: 新月

sentences.sentence: He ran across the courtyard, dodging a storm of bullets.
sentences.translation: 他跑过院子，躲避雨点般的子弹。

sentences.sentence: Germany surrendered on May 7th, 1945.
sentences.translation: 德国于 1945 年 5 月 7 日投降。

sentences.sentence: The terrorists were given ten minutes to surrender.
sentences.translation: 恐怖分子被限定在十分钟之内投降。

sentences.sentence: Alexander has been preaching patience.
sentences.translation: 亚历山大一直宣扬要坚忍。

sentences.sentence: One thing I’ve noticed is that when people have to wait, they become impatient or uncomfortable.
sentences.translation: 我注意到一件事，就是当人们在等待的时候，人们会变的没有耐心、焦躁不安。

sentences.sentence: the Gospel according to St Luke
sentences.translation: 路加福音

sentences.sentence: Ice water is the only thing that really quenches my thirst (= gets rid of it ) .
sentences.translation: 只有冰水才能让我真正解渴。

sentences.sentence: We had worked up a thirst (= done something that made us thirsty ) ，and so we decided to stop for a beer.
sentences.translation: 我们干得口渴了，因此决定停下来喝杯啤酒。

sentences.sentence: Maggie woke up with a raging thirst (= an extremely strong thirst ) .
sentences.translation: 玛吉醒来时感到口干舌燥。

sentences.sentence: Endocrine system: Group of ductless glands that secrete hormones necessary for normal growth and development, reproduction, and homeostasis.
sentences.translation: 内分泌系统：由无管腺体组成的系统，分泌激素（荷尔蒙）以供身体正常生长、 发育、繁殖和自我恒定性之需。

sentences.sentence: As an important component of the ductless inductive ventilation system, the jet inducted fan is used more and more widely in ventilation system of underground garage.
sentences.translation: 射流诱导风机作为实现射流诱导通风方式的主要产品之一，在地下车库等通风系统中得到广泛的应用。

sentences.sentence: Other endocrine glands include the pituitary, the thyroid and parathyroid, the adrenals and the ovaries and testes. Some ductless glands produce several different hormones.
sentences.translation: 其它内分泌腺有垂体腺、甲状腺、甲状旁腺、肾上腺、卵巢腺与睾丸腺。有些无管腺产生几种不同的激素。

sentences.sentence: the ridicule of his peers
sentences.translation: 他同龄人的奚落

sentences.sentence: The government’s proposals were held up to ridicule (= suffered ridicule ) by opposition ministers.
sentences.translation: 政府的提案遭到反对党部长们的嘲笑。

sentences.sentence: He had become an object of ridicule among the other teachers.
sentences.translation: 他成了其他教师嘲笑的对象。

translations.translation: 钦佩, 赞美, 羡慕

sentences.sentence: Daniel gazed at her in admiration .
sentences.translation: 丹尼尔用爱慕的眼神注视着她。

sentences.sentence: They wore blue silk dresses with cream sashes and garlands of summer flowers in their hair.
sentences.translation: 她们穿着配有米色腰带的蓝色丝质连衣裙，头上戴着夏季的花儿编成的花环。

sentences.sentence: You can never recreate the feeling of winning for the first time.
sentences.translation: 你永远无法再次体会第一次获胜时的心情。

translations.translation: 无批判力的,不加批判的

sentences.sentence: ...the conventional notion of women as uncritical purchasers of heavily advertised products.
sentences.translation: ...妇女是对广告轰炸宣传的商品不批判的购买者这一传统观点。

sentences.sentence: Then, she took Sarah Orne Jewett's suggestion to write novels about Nebraska life.
sentences.translation: 后来，她听从萨拉·奥恩·朱维特的建议开始创作反映内布拉斯加生活的小说。

sentences.sentence: Her father was the region's most distinguished doctor and, as a child, Jewett often accompanied him on his round of patient visits.
sentences.translation: 她的父亲是该地区最杰出的医生，作为一个孩子，朱伊特经常陪同他访问的病人在他周围。

sentences.sentence: In his short story A White Heron, Jewett ingeniously combines the colors of white and black with some common images that enhance the story's expressiveness and artistic appeal.
sentences.translation: 在短篇小说《白苍鹭》中，作者朱厄特匠心独具地将白和黑两种颜色与普通的意象相互结合起来，从而达到强化小说的艺术表现力和感染力的目的。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 320 单元

Galilean
音标：英 /,gæli'li(:)ən/
adj. 伽利略的, 加利利的（位于巴基斯坦北部）
例句：59About an hour later another asserted, "Certainly this fellow was with him, for he is a Galilean."
约过了一小时，又有一个人极力地说：“他实在是同那人一夥的，因为他也是加利利人。”
例句：Luke takes this passage that he finds later in Mark and he moves it and plops it down at the beginning of Jesus' Galilean ministry.
这段原本应在马可福音后半,路加把它提前到了,耶稣加利利布道的开头。
例句：At the right side of the frame is ruling gas giant Jupiter, flanked along a line by all four of its Galilean satellites.
图片右侧则是巨大的气态行星木星。 它的全部4颗伽利略卫星环绕其周围与之排成一线。

align
音标：英 /ə'laɪn/  美 /ə'laɪn/
v. 排列，使结盟
短语：align with — v. 与……结盟
例句：When war broke out, they aligned themselves with the rebel forces.
战争爆发以后，他们与叛军结了盟。

diffusely
adv. 广泛地,扩散地

caucasian
音标：美 /kɔˈkeʒən/
n. 高加索人
adj. 高加索的, 白种人的
例句：Ann Hamilton was a Caucasian from New England.
安·汉密尔顿是来自新英格兰的白人。
例句：...a 25-year-old Caucasian male.
…一位25岁的白种男子。

Korean
音标：英 /kə'riən/  美 /kə'riən/
n. 韩国人, 韩国语 a朝鲜人的, 朝鲜语的
短语：south korean — 韩国的；韩国人
短语：korean war — 朝鲜战争
短语：korean pine — 红松；海松
短语：korean air — 大韩航空公司
短语：korean barbecue — 韩国烤肉

crescent
音标：英 /'kresənt/  美 /'krɛsnt/
n. 新月, 月牙
短语：crescent moon — 新月；盈月；娥眉月
短语：red crescent — 红新月会（穆斯林国家的一种组织）
例句：a small crescent of pastry topped with cheese
顶上浇有奶酪的新月形油酥小糕点
例句：a crescent moon
新月

dodge
音标：英 /dɒdʒ/  美 /dɑdʒ/
v. /n避开, 躲避
例句：He ran across the courtyard, dodging a storm of bullets.
他跑过院子，躲避雨点般的子弹。

surrender
音标：英 /sə'rendə/  美 /sə'rɛndɚ/
v&n. 放弃, 投降
短语：unconditional surrender — 无条件投降
例句：Germany surrendered on May 7th, 1945.
德国于 1945 年 5 月 7 日投降。
例句：The terrorists were given ten minutes to surrender.
恐怖分子被限定在十分钟之内投降。

preach
音标：英 /priːtʃ/  美 /pritʃ/
v. 鼓吹
例句：Alexander has been preaching patience.
亚历山大一直宣扬要坚忍。

impatient
音标：英 /ɪm'peɪʃ(ə)nt/  美 /ɪm'peʃnt/
adj. 焦躁的,不耐心的
短语：too impatient to wait — 迫不及待
短语：impatient for — adj. 急切，渴望
短语：be impatient with — 对…不耐烦；对…感到急躁
例句：One thing I’ve noticed is that when people have to wait, they become impatient or uncomfortable.
我注意到一件事，就是当人们在等待的时候，人们会变的没有耐心、焦躁不安。

gospel
音标：英 /'gɒsp(ə)l/  美 /'ɡɑspl/
n. 〈圣经·新约〉福音书
例句：the Gospel according to St Luke
路加福音

thirst
音标：英 /θɜːst/  美 /θɝst/
n. 口渴,热望
v. 渴望
短语：thirst for — v. 渴望；热望
短语：thirst for knowledge — 渴望求知，求知欲
短语：have a thirst — [口语]想喝杯酒
短语：die of thirst — 口渴死
短语：thirst for revenge — 渴望复仇
短语：thirst after — 非常渴望
例句：Ice water is the only thing that really quenches my thirst (= gets rid of it ) .
只有冰水才能让我真正解渴。
例句：We had worked up a thirst (= done something that made us thirsty ) ，and so we decided to stop for a beer.
我们干得口渴了，因此决定停下来喝杯啤酒。
例句：Maggie woke up with a raging thirst (= an extremely strong thirst ) .
玛吉醒来时感到口干舌燥。

ductless
adj. 无导管的
例句：Endocrine system: Group of ductless glands that secrete hormones necessary for normal growth and development, reproduction, and homeostasis.
内分泌系统：由无管腺体组成的系统，分泌激素（荷尔蒙）以供身体正常生长、 发育、繁殖和自我恒定性之需。
例句：As an important component of the ductless inductive ventilation system, the jet inducted fan is used more and more widely in ventilation system of underground garage.
射流诱导风机作为实现射流诱导通风方式的主要产品之一，在地下车库等通风系统中得到广泛的应用。
例句：Other endocrine glands include the pituitary, the thyroid and parathyroid, the adrenals and the ovaries and testes. Some ductless glands produce several different hormones.
其它内分泌腺有垂体腺、甲状腺、甲状旁腺、肾上腺、卵巢腺与睾丸腺。有些无管腺产生几种不同的激素。

ridicule
音标：英 /'rɪdɪkjuːl/  美 /'rɪdɪ'kjʊl/
n. 嘲笑, 奚落
v. 嘲笑
例句：the ridicule of his peers
他同龄人的奚落
例句：The government’s proposals were held up to ridicule (= suffered ridicule ) by opposition ministers.
政府的提案遭到反对党部长们的嘲笑。
例句：He had become an object of ridicule among the other teachers.
他成了其他教师嘲笑的对象。

admiration
音标：英 /ædmə'reɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,ædmə'reʃən/
n. 钦佩, 赞美, 羡慕
短语：admiration for — 钦佩；对…赞赏
例句：Daniel gazed at her in admiration .
丹尼尔用爱慕的眼神注视着她。

garland
音标：英 /'gɑːlənd/  美 /'gɑrlənd/
n. 花环 vt戴花环
短语：judy garland — 朱迪·加兰
例句：They wore blue silk dresses with cream sashes and garlands of summer flowers in their hair.
她们穿着配有米色腰带的蓝色丝质连衣裙，头上戴着夏季的花儿编成的花环。

recreate
音标：英 /riːkrɪ'eɪt/  美 /,rikrɪ'et/
v. (使)得到休养, (使)得到娱乐
例句：You can never recreate the feeling of winning for the first time.
你永远无法再次体会第一次获胜时的心情。

uncritical
音标：英 /ʌn'krɪtɪk(ə)l/  美 /,ʌn'krɪtɪkl/
adj. 无批判力的,不加批判的
例句：...the conventional notion of women as uncritical purchasers of heavily advertised products.
...妇女是对广告轰炸宣传的商品不批判的购买者这一传统观点。

resonator
音标：英 /'rez(ə)neɪtə/  美 /'rɛzə'netɚ/
n. 共鸣器
短语：crystal resonator — 晶体谐振器；水晶振子
短语：cavity resonator — 谐振腔；空腔谐振器
短语：helmholtz resonator — 亥姆霍兹共振器

Jewett
音标：英 /'dʒu:it/  美 /'dʒu:it/
n. 朱厄特（姓氏）
例句：Then, she took Sarah Orne Jewett's suggestion to write novels about Nebraska life.
后来，她听从萨拉·奥恩·朱维特的建议开始创作反映内布拉斯加生活的小说。
例句：Her father was the region's most distinguished doctor and, as a child, Jewett often accompanied him on his round of patient visits.
她的父亲是该地区最杰出的医生，作为一个孩子，朱伊特经常陪同他访问的病人在他周围。
例句：In his short story A White Heron, Jewett ingeniously combines the colors of white and black with some common images that enhance the story's expressiveness and artistic appeal.
在短篇小说《白苍鹭》中，作者朱厄特匠心独具地将白和黑两种颜色与普通的意象相互结合起来，从而达到强化小说的艺术表现力和感染力的目的。
